gaps: No infrastructure: 'Data for the infrastructure were not available.'
No direct emissions at all are given; the dataset metadata itself says the gate-to-gate inventory excludes infrastructure and emissions, and the excerpt gives none.
Electricity is named in the text ('using gas or electricity mainly for the heating, but also for cooling') but Tab. 4.3 books the whole energy demand as natural gas, so no electricity line is added.
The raw glass throughput (1 kg of flat glass being tempered) is deliberately NOT part of this dataset: 'It includes ... but not the throughput of raw glass'. Only the 12 % production loss appears.
